name: Novotel Bangkok Impact
short_description: A 380-room convention hotel at the heart of IMPACT Exhibition and Convention Centre with a 4.7/5 ALL Rating (1,254 reviews).
ai_summary: Novotel Bangkok Impact is an international 4-star convention hotel located at the heart of Thailand's largest meeting and events venue, the IMPACT Exhibition and Convention Centre and IMPACT Arena, in Nonthaburi on greater Bangkok's outskirts. The 380-room property holds an excellent 4.7/5 ALL Rating from 1,254 reviews. Facilities include 2 restaurants, a spa, gym, swimming pool, and an elegant lobby bar, serving both MICE delegates and leisure guests. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 94 Popular Road, Banmai Subdistrict, Pakkred District, 11120 Nonthaburi, Thailand
core_facts.neighborhood: IMPACT Muang Thong Thani, Nonthaburi (greater Bangkok)
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Excellent 4.7/5 ALL Rating from a large base of 1,254 reviews
380 rooms directly at Thailand's largest convention/exhibition venue — the natural choice for MICE travellers
2 restaurants, spa, gym, swimming pool, and an elegant lobby bar
cons: Nonthaburi location is well outside central Bangkok — not ideal for leisure travellers wanting to be near the city centre
research_highlights: Located directly at IMPACT Exhibition and Convention Centre
